steps: Picked existing rig AgentRig_alt2 (AgentRig/TrainingDummy clips left untouched; new concept: a sentry scan idle — breathing + L/R weight shift + head scanning, distinct from prior anim-idle-breathe artifacts)

Built a 5-pose library in run_luau (absolute Motor6D.Transform setter): A_ex/A_in (weight on left leg, head scanning left, exhale/inhale via Waist pitch + shoulder roll), MID passing pose (centered settle dip), B_ex/B_in (mirrored right)

recipe.text: Sentry-scan idle: 4-beat cycle (weight-left exhale -> inhale -> center pass -> weight-right exhale -> inhale -> center -> close). Breathing = Waist pitch -1..+2 deg + shoulder roll +-4; weight shift = Root roll +-2.5 with unweighted knee bent -6 and head yaw +-8 scanning. All angles kept under 8 deg so it reads subtle. Keyed as absolute poses (unlisted joints identity) so no drift; feet keep identical hip/ankle roll pairs so they stay planted.
